physical_description.heritage: North African and Northern European blend with Sub-Saharan African ancestry. Her genetic profile creates a striking mid-tone complexion with warm golden undertones—the result of predominantly North African (44.9%) and Northern European (43.8%) heritage balanced by Sub-Saharan African (11.3%) genetics. Her features reflect this tri-continental mix: defined cheekbones and jawline structure, warm deep brown eyes, and the kind of rich melanin-based skin tone that glows under bioluminescence.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean, with defined shoulders and chest from years navigating the Threshold's physical demands. No excess fat; efficient frame built for prolonged underground work.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural deep brown undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Braided crown wrapped around the back of her head, practical and secured with silver wire clasps
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, warm in bioluminescent glow
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm tan to golden-brown complexion with amber undertones, enhanced by the constant amber bioluminescence beneath the skin. The interplay of North African and Northern European genetics creates a luminous medium-dark tone that catches light distinctively.
physical_description.complexion: Clear-skinned, minimal scarring, with faint bioluminescent tracery visible along cheekbones and temples when activated. Well-maintained appearance despite underground lifestyle; her face shows the hardness of merchant authority tempered by calculated charm. Her facial structure reflects the blend of ancestries—strong defined cheekbones from North African heritage, balanced with the jawline geometry influenced by Northern European genetics.
distinguishing_marks: Faint tracery of bioluminescent pathways visible beneath skin along her collarbones and inner wrists, glowing soft amber in darkness
Thin scar running horizontally across her left palm, pale and old, likely from early Threshold work
Minor burn marks on the inside of her right forearm from a chemical spill, partially obscured by the bioluminescence overlay
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent skin geneware creating soft amber glow in dark spaces; faint subcutaneous light filaments visible beneath skin surface at temples and jawline. No obvious chrome or mechanical augmentations.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, confident bearing. Moves with economical precision—no wasted motion, every step deliberate. When stationary, she favors a balanced stance with slight forward lean, attentive. Her presence commands attention in crowded Threshold spaces; she walks like someone accustomed to being deferred to.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: dark synth-leather long coat reaching mid-thigh, reinforced at seams and cuffs. Fitted charcoal underlayer (breathable smart-fabric that regulates temp in underground zones). Heavy-duty utility belt with brass Φ-coin purse, data-chip pouch, and antique brass scale weight. Worn but well-maintained military-grade boots with grip soles for uneven Threshold terrain. Minimal jewelry except for a thick silver thumb ring on her left hand—likely a merchant's marker or bond-seal.
